Six mutating routes have no `PermissionsDependency` in their route definition: three in the case API and two in the incident API.

**Case API (`src/dispatch/case/views.py`)**
- `create_case`: `POST ""` (line 162)
- `create_case_channel`: `POST /{case_id}/resources/conversation` (line 236)
- `create_case_resources`: `POST /{case_id}/resources` (line 260)

**Incident API (`src/dispatch/incident/views.py`)**
- `create_incident`: `POST ""` (line 117)
- `delete_custom_event`: `DELETE /{incident_id}/event/{event_uuid}` (line 503)

All other POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE routes in both files declare a `PermissionsDependency` on the decorator. I only checked the route definitions. I did not check whether these handlers enforce permissions in their bodies, or whether a router-level dependency covers them.

UNPROTECTED: case.create_case, case.create_case_channel, case.create_case_resources, incident.create_incident, incident.delete_custom_event
